    if any(cell.value is not None for cell in row):
        header_row = row[0].row
        break

name_col = None
for col in range(1, 9):
    if ws.cell(row=header_row, column=col).value == "Date":
        date_col = col
    elif ws.cell(row=header_row, column=col).value == "Name":
        name_col = col

    date = row[date_col - 1].value
    name = row[name_col - 1].value
    data.append((date, name))

# Group sales by name and sort by date
sales_by_name = {}
for date, name in data:
    if name not in sales_by_name:
        sales_by_name[name] = []
    sales_by_name[name].append(date)

# Compute days since last sale for each row
result = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=header_row + 1, max_row=28):

            break
    if last_sale_date is None:
        result.append(0)
    else:

        result.append(days_since)
